newsitem.title: USA: Casino restates results for fiscal 1996.
newsitem.headline: Casino restates results for fiscal 1996.

text.p: Casino Resource Corp said Friday that, because of an accounting adjustment required by the Securities and Exchange Commission, it restated its results for the fiscal year ended September 30, 1996 and the quarters ended March 31, 1996 and June 30, 1996.

Marice Gaudet, chief financial officer of the diversified entertainment company said the adjustment has no net impact on the company's stockholder's equity, as an offsetting charge of $550,000 was credited to additional paid-in capital.
The charge has no impact on cash flow as it is a non-cash item, Casino Resource said.

The company said the restated results for the quarter ended March 31, 1996 and the six-month period ending that date consist of a net loss of $1.772 million or $0.20 per share for the quarter and a net loss of $1.549 million or $0.18 per share for the six month period.
The company previously reported a net loss of of $1.494 million or $0.17 a share for the quarter and a net loss of $1.271 million or $0.15 a share for the six-month period.

For the June 30, 1996 quarter and the nine-month period ending that date, the restated results consist of net income of $183,000 or $0.02 a share for the quarter and a net loss of $1.366 million or $0.16 a share for the nine-month period.

It said the restated results for the fiscal year ended September 30, 1996 consist of a loss of $528,000 or $0.05 per share, compared with net income of $22,000 or nil per share as previously reported.
